name: Badge
description: A small pill that labels a status or a count, in five tones and three styles.

props.name: tone
props.description: The colour family: ink, water, pine, yuzu or camellia.

props.name: variant
props.description: A tint with strong text, a full fill for counts and dots, or a hairline outline.

props.name: dot
props.description: A 6 pixel dot before the text, in the tone's colour.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon before the text, sized to 12 pixels.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged with cn(). Also accepts every other prop of a span.
